# Error handling

Every error raised by the SDK is a `ZipkinError` (Java: `ZipkinException`, Go: `*Error`,
Rust: `Error`) with the same fields in every language:

| Field | Meaning |
| - | - |
| `code` | one of the codes below |
| `message` | `"<operation>: <short reason> (HTTP <status>)"` — never contains secrets, tokens, request bodies or unfiltered response bodies |
| `httpStatus` | HTTP status, when the error came from a response |
| `requestId` | vendor request id header, when present |
| `retryable` | whether retrying the same call may succeed |
| `retryAfter` | server-requested wait (`RATE_LIMITED`, `UNAVAILABLE`), when known |
| `cause` | underlying error (redacted) |

Vendor error text from a response body is redacted and truncated to 300 characters.

## Error codes

| Code | TypeScript / Python | Rust | Go | Java | Typical source | Retryable |
| - | - | - | - | - | - | - |
| `CONFIG` | `ConfigError` | `Error::Config` | `ErrConfig` | `ConfigException` | invalid or missing configuration | no |
| `AUTHENTICATION` | `AuthenticationError` | `Error::Authentication` | `ErrAuthentication` | `AuthenticationException` | HTTP 401 | no |
| `PERMISSION_DENIED` | `PermissionDeniedError` | `Error::PermissionDenied` | `ErrPermissionDenied` | `PermissionDeniedException` | HTTP 403 | no |
| `NOT_FOUND` | `NotFoundError` | `Error::NotFound` | `ErrNotFound` | `NotFoundException` | HTTP 404, missing record | no |
| `CONFLICT` | `ConflictError` | `Error::Conflict` | `ErrConflict` | `ConflictException` | HTTP 409, 412, CAS mismatch | no |
| `RATE_LIMITED` | `RateLimitError` | `Error::RateLimited` | `ErrRateLimited` | `RateLimitException` | HTTP 429 | yes |
| `VALIDATION` | `ValidationError` | `Error::Validation` | `ErrValidation` | `ValidationException` | HTTP 400, 413, 422, other 4xx, bad input | no |
| `UNAVAILABLE` | `UnavailableError` | `Error::Unavailable` | `ErrUnavailable` | `UnavailableException` | network error, HTTP 500, 502, 503 | yes |
| `TIMEOUT` | `TimeoutError` | `Error::Timeout` | `ErrTimeout` | `TimeoutException` | deadline exceeded, HTTP 408, 504 | yes |
| `UNSUPPORTED` | `UnsupportedError` | `Error::Unsupported` | `ErrUnsupported` | `UnsupportedException` | capability the service or deployment does not offer, HTTP 501 | no |
| `CANCELLED` | `CancelledError` | `Error::Cancelled` | `ErrCancelled` | `CancelledException` | the caller cancelled | no |

The client already retries retryable errors (see [Configuration](configuration.md#retry-policy));
an error you receive means the retries are exhausted or the error is not retryable.

## Handling errors

=== "TypeScript"

    ```ts
    import { NotFoundError, RateLimitError, ZipkinError } from "@grow-codes/zipkin";

    try {
      await client.ping();
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof RateLimitError) {
        console.warn("rate limited, retry after", err.retryAfterMs, "ms");
      } else if (err instanceof NotFoundError) {
        // handle missing resource
      } else if (err instanceof ZipkinError) {
        console.error(err.code, err.httpStatus, err.requestId, err.retryable, err.message);
      } else {
        throw err;
      }
    }
    ```

=== "Rust"

    ```rust
    use grow_zipkin::{Error, ErrorCode};

    match client.ping().await {
        Ok(latency) => println!("{latency:?}"),
        Err(err) if err.code() == ErrorCode::RateLimited => {
            eprintln!("rate limited, retry after {:?}", err.retry_after());
        }
        Err(Error::NotFound(_)) => { /* handle missing resource */ }
        Err(err) => eprintln!(
            "{:?} {:?} {:?} retryable={} {err}",
            err.code(), err.http_status(), err.request_id(), err.is_retryable()
        ),
    }
    ```

=== "Go"

    ```go
    _, err := client.Ping(ctx)
    switch {
    case err == nil:
    case errors.Is(err, zipkin.ErrRateLimited):
        var e *zipkin.Error
        errors.As(err, &e)
        log.Printf("rate limited, retry after %s", e.RetryAfter)
    case errors.Is(err, zipkin.ErrNotFound):
        // handle missing resource
    case errors.Is(err, context.Canceled): // also errors.Is(err, zipkin.ErrCancelled)
        return err
    default:
        var e *zipkin.Error
        if errors.As(err, &e) {
            log.Printf("%s status=%d request=%s retryable=%t: %s", e.Code, e.HTTPStatus, e.RequestID, e.Retryable, e.Message)
        }
    }
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    from grow_zipkin import NotFoundError, RateLimitError, ZipkinError

    try:
        client.ping()
    except RateLimitError as err:
        print("rate limited, retry after", err.retry_after, "s")
    except NotFoundError:
        ...  # handle missing resource
    except ZipkinError as err:
        print(err.code, err.http_status, err.request_id, err.retryable, err)
    ```

    `TimeoutError` here is the SDK class (`grow_zipkin.TimeoutError`), not the built-in.

=== "Java"

    ```java
    import codes.grow.packages.zipkin.core.NotFoundException;
    import codes.grow.packages.zipkin.core.RateLimitException;
    import codes.grow.packages.zipkin.core.ZipkinException;

    try {
      client.ping();
    } catch (RateLimitException e) {
      System.err.println("rate limited, retry after " + e.retryAfter());
    } catch (NotFoundException e) {
      // handle missing resource
    } catch (ZipkinException e) {
      System.err.println(e.code() + " " + e.httpStatus() + " " + e.requestId() + " " + e.retryable());
    }
    ```

    The exceptions are unchecked. `TimeoutException` lives in the SDK package and is not
    `java.util.concurrent.TimeoutException`. Async variants complete exceptionally with the same
    exceptions (wrapped in `CompletionException`).

## Retrying yourself

Retry only when `retryable` is true, wait at least `retryAfter` when it is set, and keep an overall
deadline. Never retry `VALIDATION`, `AUTHENTICATION` or `PERMISSION_DENIED` without changing the
request or the credentials.
